# The Second Lift

*Hamish dreams of a second lift down to the far cove. Bring him 15 Fox Sinews for his counterweight lashings, and take his drawing of the second lift to Gorm.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Town | [Goa Harbour](../towns/goa_harbour_quests.md) |
| Category | Side |
| Given by | [Hamish](../npcs/hamish_lift.md) |
| Level | 30 |
| After | [A Brush for the Rope](../quests/hamish_a_brush_for_the_rope.md) |

## Objectives

- Bring 15 [Fox Sinew](../items/fox_sinew.md) (taken)
- Talk to [Gorm](../npcs/gorm_stairs.md)

## Rewards

- 8,500 EXP
- 1,200 mesos
- [Fur-Lined Cloak](../items/fur_lined_cloak.md) x1
- +30 standing with Goa Harbour
- +200 standing with [Hamish](../npcs/hamish_lift.md)
